mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the center of the circle (the common endpoint of the radii to B and C). Right image: O names the center of the circle (the common endpoint of the segments to A and B).
Rationales: In both images, O names the center of the circle. The relevant locations are the common endpoint of the radii to B and C on the left and the common endpoint of the segments to A and B on the right.
